format: HDR1 28-byte header: ASCII HDR1, uint32LE(key,density,width,height,anchorX,anchorY), followed by 96×112 straight RGBA bytes in row-major order
coverage: Only alpha is shadow geometric coverage; 255 interior, fractional vector-boundary AA, 0 outside. RGB is SVG-rendered white mask data, never head color. Blend this coverage with the existing full shadow operation.
scope: Normal player TILE shadows 225/244/226 only; existing head resources remain unchanged. The renderer applies its normal/Christmas/source/resource guards. No runtime proof in this artwork package.
geometry: 225 circle at (6,7), radius2; 244 circle at (5.5,6.5), radius5.5; 226 independent four-cubic oblique oval centered at(5.5,6.5) with bbox(3,4,8,9). All original semantic width/height/centroid/canvas/anchor retained. Shadow origin remains original caller (x+1,y+shadowYDist).
support_policy: Smooth contours are constrained by semantic bboxes, not old pixel masks. Original-support UNION display-support handling remains a compositor requirement. No original support bitmap or game pixel data is packaged.
